task: ADR-027 (Cost Management Plan Standard and Baseline Contract): approve, reject, or request revision

criteria.description: Tier 1 cost contract after Scope and Schedule: management envelope, categories and estimating basis, staged funding, contingency versus reserve, burn-rate control, variance at plus or minus 10 percent, floors 180/700 and caps 750/4500, and STALE_DEPENDENCY to Risk and Procurement. Cost does not depend on Resource. Advisory learner advise-cost-plan-decision stays idle.
Three alternatives rejected: a single upfront budget, effort-only cost that ignores compute and API spend, and merging Cost into Schedule.
Names escalated overruns and risk-traced contingency, and the costs: early category and release rules, and a generic plus or minus 10 percent default.

Section 8 defers usage-based measurement, resolves the effort unit in practice, and leaves domain re-basing open. Section 4.5 leaves an unnamed question: whether contingency sized before the Risk plan needs an explicit re-approval when Risk is later approved.

evidence.source: direct_doc_read:docs/adr/ADR-027-cost-management-plan-standard-and-baseline-contract.md sections 4.1-4.5 and 5; keeps cost-management before risk-management because PLAN_DAG must not cycle
no fundamental flaw found in direct_doc_read of ADR-027
residual: contingency is set before an approved Risk plan and reconciled later; the ADR states this and does not hide the order
the re-approval question for contingency reconciliation sits in section 4.5 and is not copied into the numbered open questions
